findings.title: F1 stepper breaks the whole form-bug-hunt E2E suite: all 57 scenarios fill fields in sections the stepper now hides
findings.evidence: form_stepper.js:324 's.el.hidden = idx !== i;' + :540 initial show(). form-bug-hunt has 57 scenario yamls; grep for 'step-continue|stepper' across the skill = 0 matches. SKILL.md:164 'the dependents may be hidden and refused by Playwright' — harness fills via agent-browser fill in document order, no Continue handling.
findings.detail: Initial paint hides sections 2-8; every fill/upload past section 1 is Playwright-refused. The apply form's only E2E defense (consent capture, anti-fraud honeypot/timing, whitelists — defended invariants) goes dark on the next bug-hunt run, and the breakage is not disclosed in the PR body or deferred-work.md.
findings.recommended_fix: Teach the harness to drive the stepper (click data-testid=step-continue-<id> after each section, satisfying gating) or add a supported stepper-off hook for tests; get one canonical scenario green before merge. Also gives the stepper its missing E2E coverage (see W1).

findings.title: Per-file-only upload preflight block dead-ends the documents step with zero visible message
findings.evidence: form.js evaluate(): per-file breach -> setSubmitDisabled(anyPerFile) sets data-preflight-blocked but showBanner is aggregate-only; showInlineError writes textContent into .field-error which stays display:none (form.css:339). Stepper hold then finds no [data-testid=documents-section-error] banner (null) and returns — Continue silently does nothing.
findings.detail: One >5MB phone photo under the 22MB aggregate (common from phone cameras; 80% mobile traffic): gate passes (file staged), the new Continue hold fires, no banner exists to scroll to, the inline error is invisible. Applicant is stuck at the document wall with no explanation — the exact wall this project is trying to tear down. The deferred-work.md entry's mitigation claim ('the aggregate banner (visible) carries the message') is wrong for per-file-only blocks.
findings.recommended_fix: Pull the deferred one-line form.js fix into this PR (showInlineError sets style.display='flex'; clearInlineError resets), or have the stepper hold reveal .field-error[data-preflight-error] spans when no banner exists; correct the deferred-work.md mitigation sentence.

findings.title: ~250 lines of stepper DOM wiring have zero executable coverage; the header's claimed bug-hunt E2E pass does not exist; both advisory test gates output FAIL
findings.evidence: grep test file for preflight|markInvalid|__rtRecompute|dispatchEvent = 0 matches; grep .claude/skills/**/scenarios for step-continue|form_stepper|stepper-progress = 0 matches. test header: '// browser wiring (progress chrome, nav injection, anchor routing) is covered by the bug-hunt/manual E2E pass.'
findings.detail: Unpinned: form.js probe (bail), preflight hold, markInvalid server-message preservation (r1 fixes for named r0 regressions), analytics-truth synthetic input dispatch (the W0 funnel bridge), rt:form-step-changed firing, show/chrome/nav, anchor click routing. Both tests lenses' advisory gates: FAIL (P0 ~100%, P1 ~35-45% <80%). AGENTS.md disavows coverage percentages, but these are named r1 regression fixes shipped unpinned — 'tests defend named regressions'.
findings.recommended_fix: Export the probe/hold/preservation predicates for node tests (resolveAnchorTarget pattern) and/or record the DOM-glue deferral in deferred-work.md (apply_analytics precedent) with the header claim corrected; the B1 harness fix would cover the click paths end-to-end.

findings.title: documents.gleam upload-slot error visibility fix (display:flex) shipped without an SSR pin
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'display:flex|display: flex' server/test/ = 0 matches. The hunk adds '..case error { "" -> [] _ -> [attribute("style", "display:flex")] }' — a named r1 regression fix (invisible server-rendered upload errors).
findings.detail: Reverting the one-line fix — the exact bug being fixed — fails no test. Named regression fixes are exactly what the repo says tests should defend.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an SSR pin: render view_form_with_errors with a landlord_ref_primary error and assert the upload slot's field-error span carries style="display:flex".

findings.title: Radio-group error anchors resolve to a non-focusable wrapper div — the click handler's focus() silently no-ops
findings.evidence: form_fields.gleam:231 renders the radio wrapper as div.radio-options role=radiogroup with no tabindex; resolveFieldElement falls back to '[data-testid="field-<key>"]' (the wrapper) for radio groups; the handler calls target.focus() which no-ops on a non-focusable div.
findings.detail: Step switch + scrollIntoView still land the applicant on the right section, so it degrades rather than breaks — but the promised 'switch step, then focus' never focuses radio fields (a11y/UX polish on the error path).
findings.recommended_fix: When the resolved target is a non-focusable wrapper, focus its first visible radio/input (or set tabindex=-1 before focusing, the legend pattern used elsewhere in the file).

findings.title: E2E scenario content stale after F4: listing-source-tamper eval throws, happy-path fills removed field + closed address <details>, label-invariants references listing_source
findings.evidence: tamper_dropdowns inject targets name=listing_source (select no longer rendered; SKILL.md hook does s.appendChild on null). happy-path form_data includes listing_source: daft + current_address/current_city/eircode now inside the collapsed <details> (Playwright-refused). label-invariants lines 135/291 list listing_source in the visibility sweeps.
findings.detail: Distinct from B1 (harness mechanics): even with a stepper-aware harness, these scenarios' content no longer matches the form. The tamper scenario's defended surface (server-side listing_source whitelist) still exists — the field removal makes the client-injection variant impossible; rewrite as a raw POST.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop listing_source from happy-path form_data, open the address <details> (click summary) before filling it, rewrite the tamper scenario as a raw POST against the whitelist, update the label-invariants sets.

findings.title: Test header's documented run command `node --test scripts/js-tests/` fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on the repo's Node 22; only the Makefile glob form works
findings.evidence: Reproduced: `node --test scripts/js-tests/` exits 1 'Cannot find module .../scripts/js-tests' (node v22.22.0); `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` (Makefile:403) passes 52/52. Same stale line pre-exists in apply_analytics.test.js.

findings.title: Committed review-form-stepper-f1/ artifacts freeze the pre-fix r0 state with no resolution labels
findings.evidence: diff.txt:1097 'var target = resolveFieldElement(doc, id);' (the r0 anchor bug) vs shipped form_stepper.js:514 'var target = resolveAnchorTarget(doc, a.getAttribute("href"));'. blind-hunter.md/edge-hunter.md carry no fixed/deferred resolution markers (one deferred item IS recorded in deferred-work.md).
findings.detail: Committing review records fits the tracked implementation-artifacts convention, but an unlabeled pre-fix snapshot can be mistaken for the final PR diff.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a one-line header to diff.txt naming the reviewed sha/round ('superseded by the merged PR') or resolution markers on the hunter reports.

findings.title: Apply-form strings now split across two modules that each claim sole ownership; situation.gleam imports both
findings.evidence: situation.gleam imports both application/form_copy and copy. form_copy.gleam: 'All strings live here...'; copy.gleam: 'Applicant-facing brand-voice strings for the public application form... This module covers the other applicant-facing surfaces'.
findings.detail: Pre-existing overlap (documents.gleam already used copy.gleam); the PR extends it — address_cluster_summary is section copy living outside form_copy.
findings.recommended_fix: Document the division in both module docs (upload/banner copy → copy.gleam, section copy → form_copy.gleam), or move address_cluster_summary into form_copy.gleam.

findings.title: Synthetic event uses bare global Event while the same file root-qualifies CustomEvent
findings.evidence: 'sections[i].el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));' vs 'new root.CustomEvent(EVENT_STEP_CHANGED, ...)' two functions apart.
findings.detail: Harmless in browsers (Event is always a global; onContinue is browser-only wiring never exercised in node) — pattern consistency only.
findings.recommended_fix: Use new root.Event("input", { bubbles: true }) for consistency.

findings.title: .stepper-nav:empty rule can never fire — every nav row gets at least one button
findings.evidence: initBrowser bails below two sections; with >=2, every index satisfies i>0 (Back) or i<length-1 (Continue), so no nav row is ever empty.
findings.detail: Harmless defensive CSS; unreachable as written.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the rule, or comment it as purely defensive.
